PHOTO.TITLE: Pet photos
PHOTO.DESCRIPTION: Our maker works only from your photos. Four angles gives the closest likeness.
PHOTO.ERROR_FILE: Only JPG or PNG images within the size limit are accepted.
PHOTO.NOTE_RESTORE: These are ordinary image adjustments, not artificial intelligence. They make a photo brighter and sharper but cannot rebuild detail that is gone. Your original is always kept.
PHOTO.NOTE_CONFIRM: Please compare both images. The workshop only uses the restored version once you confirm it still looks like your pet.

WARNING.RESOLUTION_LOW: Image is a little small, fine detail may be lost
WARNING.OVEREXPOSED: Image is overexposed and highlights are clipped

PHOTO.QUOTA_REACHED: You have used all photo restorations for this period. Please try later or contact us.
PHOTO.RESEMBLANCE_LOW: This restored version differs noticeably from the original. Look closely at the face, the eyes and the markings before accepting it. If the pet looks changed, keep the original.

CONFIG.TITLE: Business settings
CONFIG.DESCRIPTION: The numbers that drive system behaviour. Only managers can change them.
CONFIG.MANAGER_ONLY: Your account is read-only here. Editing requires a manager account.
CONFIG.THRESHOLD_ERROR: The warning threshold must be lower than the acceptable one.
CONFIG.PET_LIMIT_HINT: Applies to accounts without their own limit.
CONFIG.QR_EXPIRY_HINT: After this the order moves to payment expired.
CONFIG.SHIPPING_DAYS_HINT: Added to production time to get the delivery estimate.
CONFIG.GOOD_THRESHOLD_HINT: Photos below this get a restoration suggestion.
CONFIG.WARN_THRESHOLD_HINT: Must be lower than the acceptable threshold above.
CONFIG.FILE_SIZE_HINT: Larger files are rejected on upload.
CONFIG.QUOTA_HINT: How many restorations one account may use. Zero means no limit for that period.
CONFIG.BANK_WARNING: This is where customer money lands. One wrong digit sends it elsewhere. Every change here is logged.
CONFIG.BANK_CODE_HINT: Exactly six digits, per the card scheme standard.
CONFIG.ACCOUNT_HOLDER_HINT: Uppercase without accents, because the payment code cannot carry them.
